## reference · Google AI Overviews SEO Impact 2026

*   **Traffic Impact**: AI Overviews reduce informational search traffic by 20–40%.
*   **CTR Penalty**: Ranking #1 no longer guarantees clicks. When an AI Overview is present, the top result’s click-through rate (CTR) drops by 58% (December 2025 data), up from a 34.5% drop in April 2025.
*   **Visibility Metric**: Being cited within an AI Overview is the primary visibility metric, driving higher trust perception and branded search volume.
*   **Source Selection**: AI Overviews prioritize sources that provide direct, factual answers over traditional long-form content; citation status is more valuable than traditional SERP position.
*   **Optimization Focus**: Shift strategy from ranking for keywords to optimizing for "Answer Engine Optimization" (AEO) and "Generative Engine Optimization" (GEO) to secure citations in AI-generated summaries.
*   **Data Variance**: AI Overview appearance rates vary significantly depending on the keyword set and tracking methodology used.

Sources: https://eseospace.com/blog/how-ai-overviews-impact-seo-2026/
